enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Sleep. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Sleep.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put down toothbrush. Pick up soap. Lather hands. Wash face. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Take out spoon. Close cupboard. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Put spoon in bowl. Pick up bowl. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl. Put bowl in dishwasher.

Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Adjust collar. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Check phone for time. Put phone in pocket. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to door. Get off bus. Walk to workplace.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a Health Care Professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at workplace. Greet colleague. Put bag in locker. Put on uniform. Wash hands. Pick up clipboard. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check patient's vital signs. Record blood pressure. Administer medication. Update patient chart. Walk to next patient. Check patient's temperature. Check patient's pulse. Adjust IV drip. Walk to nurse station. Answer phone. Write notes.

Walk to break room. Open refrigerator. Take out lunch bag. Close refrigerator. Sit at table. Open lunch bag. Take out sandwich. Take out apple. Eat sandwich. Eat apple. Drink water. Throw away trash. Walk out of break room.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a Health Care Professional
enriched_activities.desc: Return to work station. Check messages. Review patient notes. Enter patient room. Assist with procedure. Administer medication. Update records. Walk to next patient. Check vital signs. Change bandage. Talk to patient. Walk to nurse station. Answer phone. Write notes. Assist colleague. Walk to supply room. Pick up supplies. Walk back to work station.

Walk to bus stop. Check phone for time. Put phone in pocket. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to door. Get off bus. Walk home.

Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Pick up pan. Place on stove. Turn on stove. Pour oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Serve food. Walk to table. Sit down. Pick up fork. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Put plate in dishwasher.
Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out of living room.

Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Log in. Open browser. Check email. Open document. Type. Save document. Close browser. Shut down laptop. Close laptop. Stand up.
